description: T-NETWORKING-011, counter-op scoring: the counter-operative wins when the agent dies. A listen host and one client start counter-op Defection as network_counterop_mission_end_smoke does (the client is elected Anti, the host plays Joanna), with no forced mission end. 15 s into play the host's agent dies through the production death path (kill_player, playerDie); when the death animation finishes the host ends the mission for both (mainEndStage, SVC_STAGE_END, B-1193). Each machine pushes its own results: the agent's are a failed mission, the counter-operative's a completed one (GAMELOOP.COUNTEROP: results ... outcome=). The final objective statuses and both players' stats reach the client before the stage end. The client exits first from its results, then the host.
